BiblicalUsage: Besodeiah means "with the counsel of Jehovah." He was the father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah. You will find it in Nehemiah 3:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Besodeiah is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
